why: Both correctly stop at Gate 1, decline the employer build for now and ask for non-network cohort retention, but Analysis 1 also cleanly defers hiring and Android, and explicitly says the prize, rating and newsletter are not product traction, while Analysis 2 lists those as evidence of good and leaves hiring open. Analysis 1 also flags more of the missing data with tagged assumptions and gives a concrete 90-day plan, including a no-build employer test, which makes it more useful to hand to the founder.
